issue.title: 3 wait-check tests fail since 9bd351b67: deferred_unconfirmed summary field and confirmation pass double meta.json reads
issue.description:
Found by the sase-17y land agent at master 71736697d while verifying `just check` (after applying the sase-183 rename fix).

Three wait-check tests fail deterministically, and all pass at `9bd351b67^` (bisected in the same venv: 19 passed at `9bd351b67^` versus 3 failed at HEAD, once the sase-183 mypy/rename fix is applied):

- `tests/test_axe_chop_wait_checks.py::test_wait_checks_no_projects_dir_emits_noop_summary`: the summary line now reads `written=0 deferred_unconfirmed=0 reason=no_projects_dir`, but the test expects `written=0 reason=no_projects_dir`.
- `tests/test_axe_chop_wait_checks.py::test_multiple_waiting_dependencies_scan_artifacts_once`: `assert agent_meta_reads == 5` gets 10.
- `tests/test_axe_chop_incremental_scans.py::test_wait_checks_index_resolution_skips_filesystem_meta_reads`: `assert reads[0] == 0` gets 2.

ROOT CAUSE: 9bd351b67 (`fix(wait): confirm release membership before family handoff`, agent 0r1) added a `deferred_unconfirmed` summary field in `src/sase/scripts/sase_chop_wait_checks.py`. It also added a release-confirmation pass in `src/sase/core/wait_dependency_resolution/_confirmation.py`, which calls `fresh_index()` to rebuild the wait-dependency index. That rebuild re-reads agent meta.json files, so meta reads double, and the incremental index-resolution path now reads the filesystem. The commit did not update these tests.

FIX: decide whether the confirmation rebuild should reuse the already-built index or cached meta reads, since these tests pin a scan-once performance contract, or whether the tests should be updated for the new summary field and the intended extra confirmation reads. Fix the summary-text test either way.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: fails on every run at HEAD and passes on every run at 9bd351b67^ in the same venv. Assertion values (10 vs 5 meta reads; the new deferred_unconfirmed summary field) come straight from the 9bd351b67 code change.
